about_the_game:
Step into the Backrooms like never before.
Backrooms: The Levels is an immersive, atmospheric, and deeply liminal horror experience designed for players who crave psychological tension, mystery, exploration, and unsettling discoveries. Every corridor is a lie. Every sound is a warning. Every level is its own world.

This project is constantly growing and developed with exceptional dedication, shaped directly by the feedback, reviews, and suggestions from the community. Thanks to the players, the game has evolved into a deeper, stronger, and far more intense experience.

🚪 An expanding adventure — New levels every month

The first level is already available, but it is only the beginning. The upcoming levels are 90% complete and will be released month by month.
And the best part: the price of the game will not increase. Buying now guarantees access to all future levels with no additional cost.

The community plays a real role in development:
🎮 Each update includes two levels:
• 1 main level
• 1 sublevel chosen through Discord voting

Your voice shapes the future of the Backrooms.

🧩 Key Features

🔦 Authentic atmospheric horror

A perfect blend of psychological tension, liminal emptiness, and unease. Nothing feels safe. Nothing feels normal.

🏃 Free exploration & intelligent progression

Large levels with verticality, secret routes, alternate paths, and handcrafted puzzles waiting to be discovered.

🛠️ Deep gameplay improvements

• Enhanced character movement
• More realistic physics
• Complete swimming system
• Dynamic slides
• Hidden pulley mechanisms
• Smoother interactions with doors and objects

Every mechanic has been polished to feel more fluid and natural.

🎒 Item management & internal economy

A redesigned inventory system and vending machines that allow players to buy and sell items to progress smartly.

💾 Reliable progression

A stable and optimized save system designed for a continuous, loss-free experience.

🔊 Immersive 3D audio & unsettling ambience

• New ambient soundscapes
• Realistic footsteps
• Enhanced echoes and reverb
• Dynamic audio based on materials

Every sound matters—and not all of them come from something human.

🌍 Expanding localization

Refined translations and new languages added with every update.
The goal is global accessibility.

✨ Striking visual design

• Reworked materials and textures
• Improved Lumen lighting
• Real-time reflections
• Deeper shadows
• Enhanced liminal aesthetic

Every level is crafted to be visually unforgettable.

🚀 Performance for all PCs

• Improved NVIDIA DLSS
• Optimized AMD FSR
• More FPS, less latency, more stability

📚 Note Archive & Deep Lore

Every note you find is automatically saved.
Uncover connections between levels.
Find hidden clues.
Explore a fragmented story inside an infinite, nonsensical world.

💛 Built together with the community

This game evolves alongside its players.
Every comment matters.
Every review contributes.
Every update reflects the community’s support.

Join the official Discord, vote for upcoming sublevels, and become part of a project that continues to grow.

🟡 If you love psychological horror, liminal spaces, mystery, and exploration… this game is for you.

Buy now, join the development, and enter the endless maze where nothing makes sense… except surviving.

name: Backrooms The Levels

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10+(64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-4460, 2.70GHz or AMD FX™-6300 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 2080 or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: No
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Requires a GPU with Ray-Tracing support
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: WINDOWS® 10+ (64-BIT Required)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7 3770 3.4GHz or AMD equivalent or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 3080 or newer
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 MB available space
  • Sound Card: No
  • VR Support: No
  • Additional Notes: Requires a GPU with Ray-Tracing support

short_description: Experience two perspectives in a surreal psychological horror journey through body-cam, inspired by liminal spaces. No monsters—just the unsettling fear of getting lost in the unknown. Dare to enter?
supported_languages:
English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Spanish - Latin America*, Portuguese - Brazil*, Russian*
